verdict.rationale: Docs show git-workflow integration (droid-cli git workflow, PR/MR review via /review, readiness reports per repo, merging from App/terminal) implying repo-connected agent work that can review and act on pull/merge requests, but no explicit doc snippet describes the GitHub repo-connection flow or Droid opening new PRs itself. missing for 10: explicit GitHub OAuth/connect-repo setup docs, explicit 'open a pull request' action documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of PR creation.
